reviews.comment: (I had her for 210) - This class is an easy A if you do everything assigned.  Nothing is difficult by any means, but it is ALOT of busy work… discussion posts, projects, etc. would only recommend taking if you have a lighter semester. Some profs might be easier, but from my experience, it was an easy A.

This prof gave so much busywork for an english class. It was terrible do not take if you are going to have a busy semester you will have at least 1-3 papers a week not including long discussion posts.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She is super nice I took engl 330 with her. I have not taken an English since highschool and she made the curriculum very doable and was super helpful when it came to writing papers. She is super caring and tries to get to know everyone. I would definitely take another one of her classes. There are a few reading quizzes ,but they're easy.

very laidback and friendly. attendance was graded so keep that in mind if you want to skip a few lectures and still get an A. she provides clear and helpful feedback and was overall a more relaxed grader, just be very precise about MLA formatting. no tests, just essays and minor writing assignments. fun selections for class readings.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: PLEASE TAKE HER! Barros is one of my favorite English professors I have taken. She is funny, caring, and respectful. She is always willing to help you with an assignment and will give you feedback that will actually help you do better. She truly wants you to succeed in her class and does her best to make a fun and enjoyable learning environment.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: The one reason I did not enjoy this class was because of how she grades her students rough drafts, which are supposed to have mistakes. She also went on to grade the final draft for more of a percentage but having rough drafts being a percentage of your grade not only affected me but also others in the class. Would have got an A if not graded.
